Date: Mon, 3 Nov 2025 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Runbook & technical demo — scheduling

Connor — thanks for the quick turnaround on the initial demo plan. After syncing internally this morning, we've had a couple additional asks: our security lead (Alisa) and procurement team want a deeper technical runbook and a separate procurement/Q&A block so they can validate controls and contract terms.

Can we expand the session to include a security deep-dive (30–45 min) and a procurement review (30 min)? That likely pushes the session length beyond the original slot.

High-level asks:
- Security: network boundary, key management, logs/audit retention, SOC2 evidence cadence.
- Procurement: draft SOW, standard SLAs, data processing terms.

We prefer back-to-back blocks rather than separate days. Availability window: Nov 11–13 in the mornings (PT). Let me know what you can do and whether you prefer to split into two consecutive blocks (e.g., 90 + 30) or one extended session.

Thanks,
Matt
Director of IT — StrataHealth

Matt — appreciate the heads up and the clear asks. We can absolutely surface those areas and recommend splitting into two consecutive blocks to keep focus:

Proposal (suggested):
- Block A (90 minutes): technical runbook + infra deep-dive (platform, NVMe/KV cache, network patterns, typical latency profiles).
- Break (10 minutes)
- Block B (45 minutes): security deep-dive followed by procurement Q&A and SOW discussion.

Benefits: security gets a focused portion with room for controls review; procurement can ask contract-level questions right after. We can circulate a short pre-read (security checklist + draft SOW) so your teams can come with specifics.

I've attached a working SOW and a security questionnaire template to accelerate procurement + security prep. If that works, tell me which of Nov 11 / Nov 12 / Nov 13 mornings (PT) you'd prefer and whether you want 90/45 or 60/30 (shorter).

Attaching: RWI_SOW_v1.2.pdf; security-questionnaire-strata.xlsx

—Connor
